jobs.description:
TL;DR - We're looking for someone to own how Lovable shows up on social.
You'll manage a team of ICs while still spending part of your time doing creative work (copywriting, storyboarding, directing). You must be based in Stockholm or be ready to relocate.
You'll turn releases, features, and behind-the-scenes product work into posts people actually want to engage with. And you’ll set the standard your team works to, creating content for an audience of over 1 million engaged users and community members.
Why Lovable?
Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.
We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
What we’re looking for
12+ years of experience in social media with at least 2 years of managing a team
Strategic thinking: You know what content belongs on each channel, and which doesn’t, and you can confidently make that case to stakeholders
Product marketing aptitude: You understand how to turn a changelog or a feature launch into a story that matters to people
Technical communication skills: You can take a powerful feature and write about it in ways that resonate with both developer and general audiences
Visual chops: You can create your own product visuals — screen recordings, GIFs, static graphics — or draft a clear brief for Creative teams to work from
Cross-functional range: You're comfortable working directly with PMM, Product, and Creative, and know how to get what you need from each
Platform-native instincts: You live on X and LinkedIn and understand deeply what each platform actually rewards
A portfolio of product social content you've shipped that you're proud of
Experience using Lovable (genuinely — it'll show)
You’re based in Stockholm — or ready to relocate

What you'll do
Lead the team
Manage and grow Lovable’s social team
Establish an opinionated social media channel strategy and activate the team to deliver against it
Set the bar for what "good" looks like: give feedback, review work, and help reports do their best work
Split and prioritize the team's workload across launches, always-on content, and community engagement
Build a cadence and format library for product content, so every release has a clear path to social, and your team has a system to work from
Report on and be accountable for team’s metrics

Be hands-on
Own social media content related to Lovable's product: launches, features, product education, and the work behind them
Write copy that turns technical concepts into posts a broad audience will follow and want to share
Work with our Creative team on launch videos and polished static assets
Partner with Product Marketing and Product to get early visibility into what's shipping and shape how it's announced
Deepen Lovable's product usage and credibility among both a developer and general audience
Track what resonates and feed those learnings back into how you and your team plan future launches

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?
On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.
Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.
About the position
As a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.
Typical responsibilities include:
Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care
Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions
Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations
Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams
Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathways

The position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.
Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian
Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting
Valid driver’s licence (Class B)
Professionally engaged and responsible
Strong teamwork and adaptability skills
Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantage

We offer
Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions
Free Norwegian language training provided
A stable and predictable working environment
Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities
A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed
Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education
Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work
Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process
Support with housing and relocation when needed

Life in Snåsa
Snåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.
For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.
Interested?
Feel free to contact us for more information or submit a short application today!

TL;DR - We’re looking for a seasoned brand marketer with a distinctly European perspective to partner with our head of brand marketing to continue to evolve the brand and shape campaigns that don’t just buy impressions, but travel organically.
This is a planner's role with a marketer's accountability. You’ll split your time between two crafts: the thinking (cultural research, strategy, creative briefs) and the doing (orchestrating integrated campaigns and directing awareness media through our agencies). You must be based in Stockholm (or ready to be) and have experience launching campaigns in Europe, although the scope of the role will be global.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
12+ years of experience designing and launching campaigns that get talked about.
You're based in Stockholm, or ready to be.
You've built or shaped a brand inside an early stage or high-growth tech company where the category is still being defined and the roadmap moves fast.
You've led European brand campaigns end to end — strategy, brief, production, launch — across more than one market.
Working relationships with European creative talent and with media agencies you can call on day one.
You've written briefs that shipped great work, and you can show them.
You know how awareness media gets bought — enough to direct agencies, challenge plans, and own the results.

What you’ll do
Support head of brand marketing with ongoing evolution, refinement, and enablement of brand strategy.
Work with brand design to build and steward brand systems that keep Lovable consistent and distinct as we scale.
Be the HQ champion for the brand, helping to educate teams across the company on how to best represent and embody the brand in all decisions.
Measure brand health and creative effectiveness and use those insights to continuously sharpen strategy and creative.
Conduct culture research, study human behavior, and uncover deep emotional insights to drive creative and campaign strategy.
Write beautifully structured briefs that define for creative teams the exact story the brand needs to tell in a particular campaign.
Set direction for where and how the campaign should show up (e.g., experiential pop-ups, TV spots, social, etc) with an emphasis on doing the unexpected whenever possible.
Orchestrate integrated campaigns, ensuring marketing channel owners understand the story, timeline, and goals are met or exceeded.
Direct global agency partners on awareness media buying.

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.occupation: Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
jobs.description:
Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
About the role
We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness to lead and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.
This role combines people leadership, program execution, and cost competitiveness. You will ensure that key development, industrialization, improvement, and transformation initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong execution, and measurable business impact.
A central part of the role is driving our Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) agenda, identifying and implementing opportunities to reduce product and manufacturing costs while maintaining or improving quality, reliability, and customer value.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, and Finance to turn business priorities into successful programs and projects.
Key responsibilities
Lead the Program & Project Management organization
Lead, coach, and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.
Establish effective ways of working, governance, and project management standards.
Ensure projects are prioritized, resourced, and executed according to business needs.
Support teams in managing risks, resolving issues, and improving project performance.
Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Program Management & Strategic Execution
Translate business strategy into executable programs and projects.
Maintain program and project roadmaps and manage priorities and dependencies.
Ensure projects are aligned with strategic and financial objectives.
Monitor progress, risks, resources, costs, and expected benefits.
Provide transparent reporting and facilitate timely decision-making.

Drive VAVE & Cost Competitiveness
Establish and lead a structured VAVE process across products and manufacturing.
Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities with measurable business impact.
Lead cross-functional workshops and initiatives involving Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, and Finance.
Drive Design-to-Cost and Design-for-Manufacturing activities.
Build and maintain a pipeline of cost-saving initiatives and ensure benefits are tracked and realized.
Verify savings together with Finance while safeguarding quality, reliability, and customer requirements.

Cross-functional Leadership
Build strong collaboration across functions.
Drive fact-based decision-making and root-cause problem solving.
Challenge existing solutions and encourage continuous improvement.
Ensure focus on speed, simplicity, and execution.

Hands-on Leadership
While primarily a leadership role, you will also take personal ownership of selected strategic and complex initiatives, including major transformation programs and critical VAVE projects.
Leadership expectations
We are looking for a leader who:
Takes ownership and delivers results.
Creates momentum and drives execution.
Makes decisions based on facts and business priorities.
Holds teams accountable while building trust and engagement.
Communicates clearly and effectively across the organization.
Leads through influence and develops people and capabilities.

Success in the role requires the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Qualifications
Required
Several years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related industrial environment.
Proven track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
Experience managing and developing people.
Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies.
Experience with cost-reduction, VAVE, Design-to-Cost, or similar initiatives.
Strong business and financial understanding.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Fluent in Swedish and English.

Preferred
Experience from manufacturing industries.
Engineering or technical university degree.
Experience with product development and industrialization.
Knowledge of Lean, continuous improvement, or operational excellence.
Experience with manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing/Assembly.
Familiarity with ERP, PLM, MES, or project management systems.
Project or Program Management certification.

Personal profile
You combine strong leadership capability, technical understanding, and business acumen. You are:
Results-oriented and structured.
Hands-on and action-focused.
Commercially minded and analytical.
Collaborative and influential.
Confident in challenging the status quo.
Decisive and comfortable driving change.

Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality and are motivated by turning opportunities into measurable business results.
Our mission
Lead people, programs, and projects that transform business priorities into measurable results while continuously improving the competitiveness and profitability of our products and operations through VAVE.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer at Bosch Thermotechnology AB
jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort
We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description
Join the Electric Solutions group at Bosch Home Comfort, where software engineering and DevOps come together to support the development of heat pump applications. You will work closely with engineers using model-based development approaches, building a strong understanding of how their software is designed, implemented, tested, integrated, and maintained. 
You will use that understanding to shape reliable, practical tools and workflows that make continuous software development easier. From fast feedback during development to reproducible builds and releases, your work will help teams deliver high-quality software with confidence. 
Your contribution to something big:
Enable continuous development: Design and improve CI/CD workflows that support the way software teams work, from early development and integration through testing and delivery.
Enhance automation: Automate builds, tests, code analysis, packaging, and release activities, with useful feedback that helps engineers identify issues early.
Put software quality first: Consider what matters throughout the development lifecycle, including testability, reproducible builds, version control, traceability, and maintainability.
Partner with engineers: Collaborate with software teams and turn real needs into effective platform improvements.
Improve developer experience: Reduce repetitive manual work and help teams integrate and validate changes frequently and reliably.
Keep delivery systems dependable: Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot build and integration issues, and address bottlenecks across teams and sites.
Scale delivery infrastructure: Contribute to reliable and scalable build infrastructure, including cloud-based services.

Qualifications
What distinguishes you:
Education: 
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. 

Professional Experience & Skills: 
Methodologies: Solid experience in software development, CI/CD, DevOps and agile practices at scale.
Programming: Practical programming skills in Bash, Git, Python, Go, and C. 
Operating Systems: Practical knowledge with Linux and Windows systems.
DevOps Tooling: Practical knowledge of Jenkins, SonarQube, jFrog Artifactory, Bitbucket, Jira, and GitHub.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools (Ansible, Terraform) and server administration (Windows/Linux) is a plus.
Additional Tech Stack: Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, NoSQL databases (such as MongoDB), Grafana, Conan, and Maven is beneficial.

Interpersonal & Language Skills: 
Languages: Fluent in English
Working Style: Highly organized, collaborative, proactive, and structured with strong planning capabilities. 
Personality: Responsible, self-driven, eager to innovate and continuously learn, with a strong willingness to collaborate within international teams (including willingness for occasional business travel). 

Additional Information
Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

Competitive salary, Pension plans, health insurance, and other benefits according to the collective bargin.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work options (depending on role).
Employee discounts on Bosch products.

jobs.occupation: Global PV Risk Minimization Physician  Injectable Aesthetics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Global PV Risk Minimization Physician to join our Global Pharmacovigilance organisation within Injectable Aesthetics.
This is an influential global role for a physician with deep expertise in medical device vigilance, risk management, and post-marketing safety. You will provide medical and scientific leadership across Galderma's portfolio of injectable aesthetic medical devices, helping ensure that patient safety and benefit-risk considerations remain at the centre of product lifecycle management and strategic decision-making.
Working in a highly collaborative international environment, you will partner with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams. Together, you will shape safety strategies, guide regulatory interactions, and contribute to decisions that impact healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.
This is a unique opportunity to combine scientific expertise, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership in one of the most innovative and rapidly evolving areas of dermatology.
 
Your mission
As Global PV Risk Minimization Physician, you will provide medical leadership for post-marketing safety and risk management activities across Galderma's Injectable Aesthetics medical device portfolio.
You will play a key role in shaping global safety strategies, leading benefit-risk evaluations, and driving initiatives that support the safe use of our products throughout their lifecycle. Working in close partnership with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams, you will contribute scientific expertise that informs critical business and regulatory decisions.

In this role, you will:
·      Lead medical assessments of safety data, emerging signals, and benefit-risk profiles.
·      Drive risk minimisation strategies and support their implementation globally.
·      Provide expert input into regulatory submissions, safety reports, and product labelling.
·      Support interactions with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and Notified Bodies.
·      Contribute to safety governance and cross-functional decision-making.
·      Strengthen inspection readiness and support a culture of compliance, patient safety, and continuous improvement.
·      Act as a trusted scientific partner across the organisation and help shape the future of Injectable Aesthetics at Galderma.
 
Your profile 
You are a physician with a passion for patient safety and a strong scientific mindset. Drawing on extensive experience in medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities, you combine deep medical expertise with the ability to navigate complex global environments and build strong partnerships across functions, cultures, and geographies.
You are comfortable translating complex scientific data into clear recommendations and practical actions, influencing stakeholders at different levels, and balancing strategic thinking with operational execution. With strong scientific judgement, a collaborative approach, and high ethical standards, you thrive in a dynamic international environment where patient safety, quality, and compliance are at the centre of decision-making.
 
What you'll bring:
Medical Doctor (MD) qualification.
10-15 years of relevant experience within global medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities.
Strong knowledge of benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, safety surveillance, and risk minimization.
Solid understanding of global medical device regulations and vigilance requirements.
Experience interacting with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and/or Notified Bodies.
Knowledge of epidemiology, statistics, and safety data evaluation.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex safety data and translate insights into action.
Proven ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders within a global matrix organization.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively across functions and cultures.
A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented mindset.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

 
Additional qualifications in Clinical Pharmacology, Drug Safety, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biomedical Engineering, or related disciplines are considered an advantage.
 
Location and information 
This position is based on-site in Uppsala, Sweden. 
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Engineer, Biomass conversion and Mechanical Fiber

jobs.occupation: Looking for travelling Service Technician - Stockholm Region
jobs.description:

In this role, you will be based from your home and travel daily to customer sites using a company service vehicle. Your assignments will be centrally planned by service coordinators at the headquarters in Stockholm. Your primary work area will be the Stockholm Region, although assignments in other parts of the Nordic region can occur as well. 
You will be part of a team and report to the Team Leader within Mettler Toledo's Product Inspection and Transport & Logistics segments. 
This means that your customers will primarily be found within the food industry, pharma, manufacturing sector, and transportation and logistics industry. The products you will work with are related to inspection, measurement, and weighing processes. The overall purpose of your role is to ensure that our products are installed, calibrated, and maintained correctly. 
Customer communication and documentation of completed work are important parts of the role. Onboarding and continuous training are also included. 
Key Responsibilities:
Installation, troubleshooting, repairs, calibration, and preventive maintenance of Mettler Toledo products and instruments 
Administration within the CRM system 
Ensuring a high level of customer service 
Active collaboration with colleagues such as service technicians, planners, and sales representatives 
Participation in training sessions and meetings organized by Mettler Toledo 
Contributing to and upholding Mettler Toledo's corporate values and code of conduct

What You Need to Succeed
To succeed in this role, you are curious, service-minded, and technically inclined. 
You are solution-oriented, flexible, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and quality, you consistently deliver effective solutions and excellent service. 
Qualifications: 
Technical background in electrical engineering, automation, or mechanics 
Experience troubleshooting technical equipment and strong knowledge of electronics 
General IT proficiency, including experience working with PCs and Microsoft Office 
Well-organized, service-oriented, positive, and flexible regarding working hours and travel 
Valid Category B driver's license and enjoys being on the road 
Strong administrative skills 
Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Our Offer to You
In addition to great colleagues and a varied, meaningful job, we offer excellent development opportunities and regular training courses. Service training is typically conducted in Switzerland and Germany, and on-the-job training alongside experienced colleagues is also provided regularly.   
Benefits at Mettler Toledo Sweden: 
Company car  
Wellness allowance (fitness benefit)  
Edenred lunch benefit  
Monthly reimbursement for home office expenses  
Access to the Benifex benefits portal (including exclusive company discounts for personal use)  
Opportunity to apply for a First Card corporate credit card  
Occupational pension plan (ITP1/ITP2)

jobs.occupation: Snickare till längre uppdrag i norra Finland
jobs.description:
Erfarna snickare sökes till längre uppdrag i norra Finland / Experienced carpenters wanted for longer assignments in northern Finland
LETA Consulting AB söker erfarna och utbildade snickare för längre uppdrag hos våra kunder i norra Finland. Har du yrkesstolthet, flera års erfarenhet och letar efter nästa steg i din karriär? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!
Vi samarbetar med etablerade aktörer inom byggbranschen och söker nu duktiga snickare till projekt inom nyproduktion, renovering och industriella byggnationer. Uppdragen är långsiktiga och för rätt person finns goda möjligheter till fast anställning direkt hos kund.
LETA Consulting AB is looking for experienced and trained carpenters for longer assignments with our clients in northern Finland. Do you have professional pride, several years of experience, and are looking for the next step in your career? Then we would love to hear from you!
We work with established players in the construction industry and are now looking for skilled carpenters for projects in new construction, renovation, and industrial building. The assignments are long-term, and for the right person, there are good opportunities for permanent employment directly with the client.
Om tjänsten / About the job
Som snickare via LETA Consulting blir du en del av vårt kompetenta team på plats ute hos kund. Du arbetar heltid enligt finska kollektivavtal och placeras i projekt i norra Finland. Vi hjälper till med praktiska frågor såsom boende och resor, så att du kan fokusera på det du är bäst på – ditt hantverk.
As a carpenter through LETA Consulting, you become part of our skilled team on-site with the client. You work full-time according to the Finnish collective agreement and are placed in projects in northern Finland. We help with practical matters like housing and travel so you can focus on what you do best – your craft.
Vi erbjuder dig / We offer you
- Anställning enligt finska arbetsvillkor och kollektivavtal - Lön enligt avtal - Långsiktiga uppdrag hos etablerade kunder - Hjälp med boende och praktiska arrangemang - Möjlighet till övergång till kund för rätt person - Trygghet och stöd från en erfaren arbetsgivare - Start omgående och löpande
- Employment according to Finnish working conditions and collective agreements - Salary according to the agreement - Long-term assignments with established clients - Help with accommodation and practical arrangements - Opportunity to transition to the client for the right person - Security and support from an experienced employer - Immediate start and ongoing opportunities
Vi söker dig som har / We are looking for someone who has
- Yrkesbevis eller motsvarande utbildning som snickare - Gedigen erfarenhet inom byggbranschen - Självständig arbetsstil och god samarbetsförmåga - B-körkort är meriterande - Talar svenska, finska eller engelska (koncernspråket är engelska)
- A professional certificate or equivalent education as a carpenter - Solid experience in the construction industry - An independent working style and good teamwork skills - A driver's license (B) is a plus - Speaks Swedish, Finnish, or English (the company language is English)
📩 Ansökan / Application
Skicka in ditt CV via länken i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post på grund av GDPR. Sista ansökningsdag är den 30 november men vi rekryterar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt!
Submit your CV via the link in the ad. We do not accept applications by email due to GDPR. The last application date is November 30, but we are recruiting continuously, so send in your application as soon as possible!
Frågor? / Questions?
Kontakta gärna / Feel free to contact Johan Larsson 📧 johan.larsson@letaconsulting.se  +46 76-800 23 43
Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att matcha dig med ditt nästa bygguppdrag!
We look forward to receiving your application – we’re excited to match you with your next construction assignment!

The opportunity 
At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact on our communities and society.
We are in a steep expansion, and you will be part of Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems business unit in Landskrona. We have a global responsibility for the development and manufacture of cooling systems for Power Electronic applications and other applications that require water cooling systems with high reliability and availability.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the green transition and create a more sustainable energy future for all. So, if you want to take the next step in your career, and contribute to develop a stronger, smarter, and greener energy system – Join us now, we are ready for you!
How you´ll make an impact
Plan, schedule, and perform regular inspections and maintenance activities to help prevent equipment fail-ures and minimize production downtime.
Manage and maintain service agreements with external maintenance providers.
Troubleshoot and carry out repairs promptly in response to equipment failures or unplanned shutdowns.
Support and promote operator maintenance activities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and 5S practices from a maintenance perspective.
Perform and coordinate calibration of instruments and equipment.
Identify and initiate equipment upgrades to improve reliability, efficiency, and performance.
Manage the procurement of maintenance-related equipment, tools, and spare parts.
Work closely with Production and Production Engineering teams to improve machine performance, extend equipment lifespan, and support energy-efficiency initiatives.
Ensure machinery, equipment, and maintenance activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

Your Background
You have a technical background and solid experience working with structured maintenance in a production or manufacturing environment.
Experience with Lean principles and 5S methodologies is considered an advantage.
You are proactive, collaborative, and solution-focused, with a strong drive to achieve results.
You build positive relationships and communicate respectfully and effectively with colleagues, customers, and external partners.
You can identify opportunities for improvement and help implement practical solutions related to equipment reliability and performance.
You are organized and able to manage priorities effectively, meet deadlines, and maintain a calm, problem-solving approach in a fast-paced environment.
You have strong communication skills and are comfortable expressing yourself clearly in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. 
Our benefits offering for our roles generally include:
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances. 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) 
Health care and wellness allowance 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks 

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and type of contract. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.   
 Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application today.
Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Elina Mannelqvist, elina.mannelqvist@hitachienergy.com
Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Senad Dizdar, +46 (72) 2303665; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107 38 70 43; Unionen: Nils Hörnfalk, +46 (72) 2199386

Snapshot of your day 
We are looking for a Wind Technician who enjoys a dynamic and diverse role, while also taking pride in performing routine maintenance tasks! In this position, you’ll be responsible for servicing and maintaining wind turbines at our customers’ wind farms. 
How you’ll make an impact 
In this role, you will primarily perform maintenance and troubleshooting on wind turbines near Mariannelund, Sweden. You will be based at our hub in Mariannelund and travel to our two sites in the surrounding area. This position offers the opportunity to apply your knowledge of electricity, hydraulics, and mechanics. Together with your team, you will solve on-site issues to ensure high operational reliability and deliver excellent service to our customers. 
Other responsibilities and duties 
A great part of the job is ensuring that on-site work is always carried out with safety as the highest priority. For electrical work, we work according to the Swedish electrical standard (SS-EN 50110-1). 
You will be supporting our customers both remotely and onsite and will perform service operations and resolve product issues. This includes carrying out improvement measures and modifications. 
You will play a key role in ensuring that the annual maintenance is completed on time, carried out efficiently, and documented in a structured and organized manner. 
You are responsible for reporting and documentation of your work. 
You will work together with Siemens Gamesa colleagues but also with subcontractors. Good collaboration is an important part of your daily work. 

Our employee’s knowledge is important to us. Therefore, at the beginning of your employment, you will participate in various training programs designed to support and accelerate your development with us at Siemens Gamesa. 
 
What you bring 
Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change, but also: 
High school education or equivalent experience with a technical and/or focus on electricity and/or mechincal is advantageous. 
Experience in wind power is an advantage. 
Fluent in English, written and oral. Swedish is advantageous. 
Very comfortable working on high heights. 
Good computer knowledge. 
Driving license B is a must, as you will be driving to our sites. 

 
If you get offered the position, you will need an approved health check and a drug test before you start. 
We are looking for someone with strong communication skills and a flexible attitude, who has a genuine interest in technology and enjoys learning new skills. You should thrive in a team-oriented environment, collaborating effectively with colleagues and contractors, while also being proactive and capable of driving tasks forward independently.
As you'll be working in a fast-paced setting with demanding responsibilities, the ability to adapt to evolving situations and challenges is essential. As a person you are responsible and have a high safety awareness. 
 
Who is Siemens Gamesa?
Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.
At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html
 
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 
 
Application deadline: 31.10.2026, but ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. 
Location: Mariannelund and surrounding areas.

Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As part of the team, you will play an active role in planning, implementing, and monitoring projects.
You will also take independent responsibility for project streams and sub-projects and drive them forward in a targeted manner.
You will create templates and compelling presentations for our stakeholders and also provide support with administrative tasks.
With the help of sound project data analyses, you will identify key areas for improvement and thus actively contribute to our continuous development.
You will be actively involved in the development and implementation of new processes and methods in project management.
You will independently develop meaningful presentations for project management in PowerPoint, thereby preparing important decisions.
You will carefully collect all open issues in OneNote as an OPL (Open Point List) and ensure their transparency.
You will precisely monitor the consistent tracking of milestones and deliverables to ensure continuous project progress.

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying in business administration, economics, engineering, project management, or similar as Master student
Solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work independently and to take responsibility for own work
Experience in proficient in MS Office; basic knowledge of project management methods and tools such as Jira or PowerBI is an advantage
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, e.g. Word, Excel, Power Point
You are characterized by a reliable, structured, and independent approach as well as clear and open communication; you think analytically, can quickly familiarize yourself with complex issues, and enjoy proactively developing innovative solutions with creative ideas; you enjoy working in a dynamic team
Enthusiasm: for new projects; you are motivated to continuously develop yourself both personally and professionally through the use of modern methods and digital tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English - Swedish is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
We offer monetary compensation to support you during your internship.
Free accommodation in Tranås is provided
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “7 to 16” you, because life is all about balance.
At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. Let ‘s strike a balance. At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.
Join us and feel the difference. #LikeABosch

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Senior Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining automated production systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving PLCs, robots, and other automated equipment, supporting both new production line installations and ongoing process improvements. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with cloud platforms to enable traceability, analysis, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production.  

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead automation system integration during equipment commissioning (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop the automation systems that are to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on process control.  
Code review and test of suppliers work within the projects to validate specified functionality and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor. 
Develop and maintain automation programming standards 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 
Masters Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with sensors, instrumentation, servo drives and motion technology. 
Experience with PLC, SCADA, vision systems and CCD cameras and software, OPC connectivity and MES interfaces, especially using Siemens and/or Beckhoff systems. 
Experience with industrial communication protocols and network architecture including design of control systems architecture and PLC code delivering the desired system functionality. 
Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 
Experience in writing technical documentation (Requirement specifications, Functional design, UML, Test Cases, Test Records). 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.  
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz Sverige AB
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As a E-Com Lead, you contribute to digital commercial performance by planning and executing daily product exposure on .com and app, ensuring the offer is relevant, visible, and aligned with commercial priorities. You work closely with stakeholders to align actions and continuously improve the end‑to‑end digital shopping journey across customer groups.
Your main responsibilities are:
Publish content on .com and app according to QCP and in alignment with Marketing calendar
Manage day-to-day execution of product exposure and optimize ranking, including deals and discount activities, according to QCP and ad-hoc adjustments to secure optimal performance
Use data‑driven insights to optimize navigation, exposure tactics, deals, and ranking for continuous commercial improvement.
Optimize internal search (e.g., add synonyms)
Commercial Leads manage commercial plan per customer group and will give input on campaigns, activations and product strategies (including ranking)
Experience Leads manages overall site plan and will give input on actions to ensure a seamless end-to-end digital shopping journey across customer groups.
Partner closely with E com leads, Digital experience lead, Commercial leads and Customer Activation teams to align actions and share insights that strengthen digital performance.

 
WHO YOU ARE​
We are looking for people who are...
Strong team players who enjoy collaborating with others
Driven and committed to delivering great results
Detail oriented and thorough in their work
Eager to learn and develop new skills

We are looking for people with…​
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or related field
Preferably 2+ years’ eCommerce experience
Strong knowledge of online merchandising, UX, and site optimization
Strong analytical, commercial, and communication skills
Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and adapt to industry trends

WHO WE ARE​
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​
All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
JOIN US​
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, apply by sending your application in ENGLISH through the career site as soon as possible but no later than October 24th, 2026. As we review applications continuously, the role may be closed early.  
This is a temporary position for 1 year starting from January. The position is based in our Office in Stockholm and reports to Commercial Manager.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Turn digital marketing into growth for our clients
Clients come to us with a simple question: how do we grow? In this role, you help them answer it across paid, performance and growth marketing, by leading the work that sets the direction and gets it moving. You also shape what Comprend offers, so our solutions stay relevant as the channels and tools change.
The role
You’ll work with digital marketing at Comprend, alongside colleagues across disciplines. You lead workstreams and projects for clients, and you make sure the quality of what we deliver is high and the numbers are right. Sometimes you lead an assignment from start to finish. Other times you drive one phase and hand over to colleagues. You’re a trusted advisor to clients and colleagues, and your advice rests on deep expertise.
Your impact goes beyond your own assignments. You develop how we talk about and sell our performance and growth marketing offering, and you help others apply the standard you set.
What you’ll do:

Lead and drive paid, performance and growth marketing workstreams and projects for our clients.

Build and grow senior client relationships that create long-term value for clients and for us.

Develop the narrative and go-to-market approach for our performance and growth marketing solutions, and help the offering grow commercially.

Bring AI-supported methods and tools into our digital marketing work to improve efficiency, quality and client value.

Work across disciplines to deliver integrated, insight-driven solutions, and share knowledge across the organisation.

Stay ahead of shifts in the digital landscape and turn them into practical improvements for clients and for us.

What good looks like

Our performance and growth marketing solutions are known, inside and outside Comprend, for quality and results.

Delivery is consistently accurate and of high quality, which leads to satisfied clients and repeat business.

You contribute visibly to knowledge sharing, business development and offering development.

You help strengthen our culture and ways of working through inclusive, value-driven behaviours.

Who you are
You know performance marketing and digital growth strategy in depth, and you turn that into advice that clients and colleagues can act on. You take accountability for outcomes, balance autonomy with alignment to shared goals, and lead complex work without needing formal personnel responsibility.
To succeed in this role, you bring:

Deep expertise in performance marketing and digital growth strategy, across the full range of paid and performance channels.

Experience of developing and commercialising digital marketing offerings or solutions.

The ability to build and maintain senior client relationships that create long-term value.

A strong track record of leading complex workstreams or projects without formal personnel responsibility.

Clear, adaptable communication, with the skill to turn complex insights into client-ready recommendations.

Experience of using AI-supported tools or methods.

Professional Swedish and English.

Working at Comprend
Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge, and win as a team. This is a full-time position. We’d prefer you to be based in our office in Stockholm, but we’re open to discussing a position in Malmö. We offer a competitive employment package.
About Comprend
Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication, driving transformative impact. We’re 250+ specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland, Poland, and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. We’re a proud part of Aura, a consultancy group with seven specialist agencies and 550+ people.

Do you want to work closely with customers and help them successfully implement and use business-critical software solutions within logistics and transportation?
At IMI, we deliver SaaS-based solutions that help organizations manage warehouse operations, transportation flows, delivery visibility, and customer delivery experiences. Our solutions support customers in their daily operations and play an important role in ensuring efficient and reliable logistics processes.
We are looking for an Application Consultant to join our team. This role combines customer onboarding, solution configuration, support, and coordination of technical deliveries. You will work closely with customers throughout their journey, from implementation and training to ongoing support and continuous improvements.
About the Role
As an Application Consultant, you will become an important part of a cross-functional team responsible for onboarding new customers and supporting our existing customer base. You will work with customer implementations, system configuration, support cases, training, troubleshooting, and change requests.
The role involves close collaboration with customers, software engineers, architects, business consultants, and project managers. You will play a key role in ensuring successful deliveries while contributing to high customer satisfaction and strong customer relationships.
Key Responsibilities:
Onboard new customers and ensure successful implementations
Configure customer environments and support customers during go-live activities
Troubleshoot system functionality, workflows, and integrations
Support and train users in system functionality and business processes
Manage onboarding requests and change requests from requirement through delivery
Perform data updates and configuration changes within customer environments
Act as the link between customer needs and development teams
Gather and communicate requirements to ensure the right solutions are delivered
Drive customer cases and requests through to completion
Build strong customer relationships and contribute to customer satisfaction
Identify opportunities to improve processes, services, and ways of working

Your Profile
We believe you enjoy working closely with customers and combining technical understanding with a strong service mindset. You take ownership, are comfortable managing multiple activities simultaneously, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines.
You are curious, proactive, solution-oriented and are confident in driving issues forward, finding the right stakeholders, and ensuring that customer requests are resolved in a professional manner.
You also understand the importance of balancing customer expectations, technical quality, long-term sustainability, and business value.
We Believe You Have:
A post-secondary education in IT, Logistics, or a related field, alternatively equivalent professional experience
At least three years of professional experience in several of the following areas:

· Software delivery and customer-facing solutions
· Application configuration and administration
· Customer onboarding and implementation projects
· Support, service delivery, or application management
· Customer requirements gathering and stakeholder communication
Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with supply chain, logistics, transportation management, or warehouse management solutions
Background in a software product or SaaS company
Familiarity with SQL
Familiarity with integrations and tools such as Postman
Experience working with Azure DevOps

The position is primarily based in Linköping and offers a hybrid working model.
Why IMI?
IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.
We are proud to be Great Place To Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we provide a generous benefits package, including extra vacation days, a wellness allowance, and occupational pension contributions.
Application
Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se.

jobs.employer_name: Newsec Property Asset Management Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Newsec – the Full Service Property House in Northern Europe – offers property owners, investors, and tenants a broad range of services in Property Asset Management and Advisory. The company was founded in 1994 and is now partner-owned, with approximately 2,000 employees across all seven Nordic and Baltic countries. Newsec has approximately SEK 600 billion in assets under management, signs leases covering approximately  1,000,000 square metres annually, completes transactions worth approximately SEK 50 billion, and values properties with an underlying value of approximately SEK 1,750 billion. We strive to build a strong sense of team spirit and are proud to have high employee satisfaction and a workforce comprising both experienced experts and young talent. In the annual independent employee survey “Great Place to Work,” Newsec has been ranked as one of Sweden’s best workplaces since 2010. www.newsec.se
About the Role
Would you like to help shape a modern Nordic data platform at a company making a major investment in data and analytics? As a Data Engineer at Newsec, you will play an active role in building and managing our enterprise-wide data platform, powered by Microsoft Fabric and the Azure ecosystem. This role is ideal for a junior to mid-level engineer looking to grow alongside an experienced team while working with cutting-edge Lakehouse technology.
Working closely with Data Architects, BI Developers, and business stakeholders, you will build reliable, scalable data flows supporting analytics, self-service BI, and data-driven services across the Nordics and Baltics.
Your Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and data models in Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse).

Perform SQL-based development, continuous optimization, quality assurance, and monitoring of data pipelines.

Enable self-service BI and analytical workloads through clean, well-structured data foundation layers.

Collaborate on shared engineering practices: documentation, code reviews, version control, and platform security.
